# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_character_portrait_carrier.txt - edit the source.
# Country leader portrait carrier: the only place that writes the CAPIE portrait layer (CONTRACT
# section 18, API level 7, CAPIE 1.5). U2: the layer shows only as the civilian portrait of the
# character who rules the country now; army and navy portraits stay the game's.
#   on the character  capie_pt_s / capie_pt_len    large sprite name, packed as in 17.3
#                     capie_pt_ss / capie_pt_slen  small sprite name (always written, 18.3)
#                     capie_pt_ver = 1             layer set
#   on the country    capie_pt_rev = 1             commit, ALWAYS last (rn_country_portrait_commit)
# Mod bookkeeping on the character: rn_pt_idx (catalog index, for the picker's preview) and
# rn_pt_cat (catalog fingerprint; another one means rn_pt_idx is stale). The carrier stores the
# game's sprite names, never the mod's catalog sprites, so a save shows the same portrait after an
# update of the mod.

# Scope: the character. Input temp rn_pt_in: catalog index. An index without a portrait removes
# the layer. The caller commits on the country afterwards.
rn_character_portrait_carrier_set = {
	rn_pp_catalog = yes
	clear_array = capie_pt_s
	clear_variable = capie_pt_len
	set_temp_variable = { rn_pp_w = temp_var:rn_pt_in }
	rn_pp_write_portrait = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { capie_pt_len > 0 } }
		set_variable = { rn_pt_idx = temp_var:rn_pt_in }
		set_variable = { rn_pt_cat = temp_var:rn_pp_cat }
		set_variable = { capie_pt_ver = 1 }
	}
	else = { rn_character_portrait_carrier_clear = yes }
}

# Scope: the character. Removes the layer; the game's portrait comes back. The caller commits.
rn_character_portrait_carrier_clear = {
	clear_array = capie_pt_s
	clear_array = capie_pt_ss
	clear_variable = capie_pt_len
	clear_variable = capie_pt_slen
	clear_variable = capie_pt_ver
	clear_variable = rn_pt_idx
	clear_variable = rn_pt_cat
}

# Scope: the country. The commit: CAPIE re-reads every ruling leader. Always the last statement.
rn_country_portrait_commit = {
	set_variable = { capie_pt_rev = 1 }
}
